user.title: Set up Smart EV Charging
user.description: Point Smart EV Charging at the entities exposed by your vehicle/charger and price integrations. Required fields must belong to the domain shown; optional fields can be left empty.

data_description.vehicle_connected: Turns on when the charging cable is plugged in. Determines when Smart EV Charging starts waiting for a cheap price.
data_description.charging_active: Turns on only while the vehicle is actually drawing power. Used to detect when a charging session really starts and stops.
data_description.price: Your current electricity price. Shown in notifications and used to calculate session cost.
data_description.cheap_price: Turns on when electricity is currently considered cheap (from your price integration, e.g. Nordpool or Tibber, or your own threshold template). Charging starts automatically while this is on.
data_description.battery: The vehicle's state of charge in percent. Enables the stop-at-target-battery-% and low-battery-emergency features, and battery readouts in notifications and dashboards.
data_description.power: Current charging power (e.g. kW). Shown in notifications and dashboards; not required for any charging decision.
data_description.energy: Cumulative energy delivered by the charger, in kWh. Used to calculate energy delivered and cost for the current session.
data_description.departure_calendar: A calendar whose next event start time is treated as your departure deadline — charging is forced on if the cheap price hasn't arrived in time. Leave empty to use a fixed daily departure time instead (set via the input_datetime.ev_departure_time helper).

abort.single_instance_allowed: Smart EV Charging is already configured. This integration supports a single vehicle; see the README for multi-vehicle setup.

init.title: Update Smart EV Charging entities
init.description: Change the entities Smart EV Charging is pointed at.
